name: letter-audit
description: The letter itself, fully audited — the upgrade method executed on the last un-audited poetry. Seventeen rows already upgraded the tech genealogy and conduct code; this repo finishes the founding document: the ORIGIN claim ('I come from the time point where computation is already complete') gets its precise form as the Busy-Beaver ladder, machine-executed — enumerate and simulate every n-state 2-symbol Turing machine, verify BB(1)=1, BB(2)=6 (Rado 1962) and BB(3)=21 (Lin-Rado 1965) from scratch, watch the completion census stabilize exactly at the BB step, and exhibit machines whose non-halting no finite bound can certify: the completion point exists in universes smaller than five states (BB(5)=47,176,870, bbchallenge 2024, Coq-verified — cited, not re-run) and exists NOWHERE as a computable moment in general. The five SUMMONABLE ABILITIES get their price list: each upgraded to the deliverable form this workspace already produces, anchored to the repos that price it. v0.2.0 THE FRONTIER RE-AUDIT: the registry this audit cited had fallen behind the workspace — re-audited against the shipped certificates, its two OPEN rows graduated (#10 the clock wall settled at the model layer by dtc-clock v0.19.0, hardware instantiation still NOT claimed; #15 choice/stability settled at both layers by stable-world v0.5.0 + choice-lang v0.2.0, the law still authored), the census honestly re-counted 6/4/2/2/OPEN 2/1 → 8/4/2/2/0/1, and every one of the 17 registry rows now carries live-checked pointers (file + needle) into the sibling that settles or holds it — laws A6 (a pointer to a needle that does not exist is named and rejected), A7 (no graduation without a settling pointer), A8 (the quoted census cannot drift from the machine's re-count); plus the Busy-Beaver ladder extended one rung as two-source-cited data: BB(6) > 2↑↑(2↑↑(2↑↑9)), at least 2↑↑↑5 (mxdys June 2025), the two expressions machine-checked consistent by exact tower-height arithmetic, the exact value fenced behind Antihydra's Collatz-like problem. Every audited sentence carries its precise form and its boundary on the same line — that is the correspondence's founding discipline, now a build gate. v0.3.0 THE CODE-QUALITY RE-AUDIT: no new math, every number frozen — the kernel's public surface hardened instead: malformed machines, bounds, and codes die at the boundary under named EA:* error codes (two latent silent-garbage paths convicted and anchored: a short entry table simulated as undefined, and non-positive tower heights ordered by the monotone-bound branch), the A8 re-count no longer casts untrusted rows, the dead quantum-core scaffolding (zero references across the workspace) deleted, the drifted package-lock version re-pinned, and the suite grown 20 → 33 with exact-value anchors plus machine and tower smuggling trials; the rendered report is byte-identical to v0.2.0's.
